text: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_type, SUM(count_lifetime_orders) AS count_lifetime_orders, SUM(lifetime_spend_pretax) AS lifetime_spend_pretax, SUM(lifetime_tax_paid) AS lifetime_tax_paid, SUM(lifetime_spend) AS lifetime_spend, MIN(first_ordered_at) AS first_ordered_at, MAX(last_ordered_at) AS last_ordered_at FROM jaffle_shop.dev.customers WHERE LOWER(customer_name) = LOWER('Ryan Byrd') GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name, customer_type LIMIT 500
